task.description: Implement ADP-03 in backend API/auth and tenant-scoped request handling according to src/design/adp-03-tenant-context-resolution-api.md. Enforce deterministic tenant context resolution from bearer token claims: missing tenant_id maps to default tenant, present tenant_id scopes all request operations to that tenant, and cross-tenant access is blocked within a single request lifecycle. Update middleware/service/repository integration points required by the design without regressing API-08 behavior for legacy tokens. Add or update tests to validate default-tenant compatibility, tenant-claim scoping, and cross-tenant isolation failure paths.
acceptance_criteria: Backend request pipeline resolves tenant context deterministically for both claimed and unclaimed tokens
All ADP-03-scoped operations are tenant-bound and reject cross-tenant access
Legacy tokens without tenant_id preserve pre-migration behavior under default tenant

result.summary: Executed WF02-adp03 Step-02 backend validation for ADP-03, confirmed deterministic tenant context behavior for legacy and tenant-claim tokens, and updated ADP-03 isolation integration coverage to assert tenant-scoped reads via bpm_effective_tenant_id() within request lifecycle semantics.
